note: Example numbers are small and neutral on purpose: the recap must never show a scenario's real answers. The worked steps are computed with stats.js (js/helpers/recap.js).

cards.title: Mean
cards.what: The fair share: what each one gets if we share equally.
steps: Count how many numbers there are.

cards.title: Median
cards.what: The one in the centre, when the numbers are in order.
steps: Find the one in the centre.
Two in the centre? Take halfway between them.

cards.title: Mode
cards.what: The answer that comes up the most.
steps: Count how often each answer comes up.
Find the one that comes up the most.
That is the mode. It can even be a word!

cards.title: Range
cards.what: How spread out the answers are.

wordsNote: 🤔 Mean, median and range need numbers. Games are words, so we use the mode.
